name: Color Spray Trap

stealth.details: (trained) to notice the glyph on the doorjamb

disable: DC 25 Thievery check (trained) to disable the glyph, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the glyph

items.name: Color Spray
items.text:
Trigger The door is opened

---

Effect The trap casts Dizzying Colors on the triggering creature (DC 21 Will save).

text: A loud pop sounds when this door is opened, followed immediately by a blast of colorful lights that washes over whoever opened the door.
